# Caíque Coelho — Senior SDET (Playwright, Cypress, AI-native QA)

> Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) with 9+ years in software engineering and 8+ in test automation and quality architecture. Builds test automation frameworks in Playwright and Cypress (TypeScript), the CI/CD that runs them, and LLM agents for QA that cut release validation from ~2 hours to ~10 minutes. Contributor to the Cypress core repository and Cy.Pronauts (Cypress.io ambassador). Based in São Paulo, Brazil; relocating to the UK, the Netherlands or Spain with visa sponsorship.

## Experience

  - Built LLM agents (Claude Code, MCP) that generate test plans, validate conformance logs and triage failures: release validation from ~2 hours to ~10 minutes.
  - Leads web automation in Playwright and Cypress with TypeScript; added unit, component and Percy visual layers to an E2E-heavy suite.
- Inventa (B2B wholesale marketplace) — SDET Lead, Apr 2022 – Oct 2023. Led a team of 6 SDETs; built the Cypress framework and release quality gates; k6 and Locust performance testing.
- Zé Delivery (AB InBev) — Senior Software QA Engineer, Nov 2021 – Apr 2022. Cut flaky tests by ~60% and CI time by ~50%; introduced PACT contract testing.
- QuintoAndar (Latin America's largest real-estate rental platform) — Senior Software QA Engineer, Nov 2018 – Nov 2021. Scaled Cypress E2E and component automation through hypergrowth.
- Jera — Android Developer (Jan – Oct 2018) and QA Analyst (Jun – Dec 2017).
